description: Upload an Android (.apk), iOS (.ipa) or HarmonyOS (.hap) package from this machine to PGYER and wait until PGYER has processed it. Returns the published build with its download page URL (share it with testers) and QR code image URL. PGYER matches the package to an existing app by its package identifier, or creates the app on the first upload. Only the settings you pass are changed; the app keeps its current values for the rest. Large files can take several minutes. If PGYER is still processing when processingTimeoutSeconds ends, the result has status "processing" and a buildKey: call get_upload_status with it later instead of uploading again.

channelShortcut.description: Shortcut of a PGYER channel download link to publish this build to

description.description: App description shown on the download page

filePath.description: Absolute path of the .apk, .ipa or .hap file on this machine

installEndDate.description: Last day the build can be installed (YYYY-MM-DD); set together with installStartDate

installStartDate.description: First day the build can be installed (YYYY-MM-DD); set together with installEndDate

installType.description: Who can install: public (anyone with the link), password (needs the install password) or invite (only invited testers). Setting only password implies password.

oversea.description: true: upload through the overseas network; false: upload within mainland China. Leave out to let PGYER choose by IP address.

processingTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for PGYER to process the build after the file is uploaded (default 600)

updateDescription.description: Release notes for this build, shown on the download page

name: upload_app

buildNumber.description: PGYER build number of this upload

downloadPageUrl.description: Download page to share with testers

qrCodeUrl.description: QR code image of the download page

status.description: published: ready to install. processing: PGYER is still processing; call get_upload_status later.

version.description: Version name from the package, e.g. 1.2.0

versionCode.description: Version code / build number from the package

title: Upload app to PGYER
